work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Single Clement XII letter with printed protocol 73936 and salutation 73938-73940, continuous sections 1-8, concluding benediction 74144-74146, dating clause 74147-74148, and printed date 74149. The historical note 74134 corresponds to the same act at 74099 and is retained. Retains all source synopsis and sections without inventing subdivisions or correcting source names, words, or date typography. Previous act ends 73922; next numbered independent act starts 74152. No unresolved apparatus membership. Source-extent re-audit: the terminal dating formula at 74147-74148 is abbreviated in the literal OCR as "Datum  Piomac  ,  eie,  die  vi  oclobris" / "MDCCxxxix,  eie.". Both instances of "eie" are retained without correction or expansion; the formula has an explicit day/month/year and is followed by printed dating line 74149. The substantive letter, final benediction and independent boundary are present; no substantive body is replaced by a cross-reference.
